summary: Sandra Hochwarter works in Buddhist studies and Indology. She earned her Mag.phil. at the University of Vienna, where she studied under Anne MacDonald and completed her master's thesis under the supervision of Klaus-Dieter Mathes.
Sang-Kyun Sun is a Buddhist studies scholar who earned a PhD from the University of Delhi under doctoral supervisor Sanghasen Singh. In 1995, he held a post as a lecturer at Jingak Sangha University.

Sangay Dorji is a scholar of Tibetology, linguistics, and Buddhist studies who studied at Tengtho Goenpa and the Institute of Language and Culture Studies. He has served as a teacher at Simtokha Dzong and as Secretary of the Dzongkha Development Commission.

Sangharakshita (1925–2018) was a scholar in Buddhist and religious studies who founded the Triratna Buddhist Community in 1967. He studied at Banaras Hindu University and trained under Jagdish Kashyap, Jianmin Chen, Dhardo Rinpoche, Jamyang Khyentse Chökyi Lodrö, and Dudjom Jigdral Yeshe Dorje.

Sangseraima Ujeed is a scholar of Buddhist studies and Tibetology. She completed her doctorate at the University of Oxford (~2012–2018) and held a Robert H. N. Ho postdoctoral fellowship in Buddhist Studies at the University of California, Santa Barbara (~2018–2020).

Historian Sanjay Subrahmanyam studied at Sardar Patel Vidyalaya, St. Stephen's College, and the University of Delhi's Delhi School of Economics. His academic posts include positions at Oxford, the EHESS, the Collège de France, and the University of California, Los Angeles.
Sanjaya Lall (1940–2005) studied at St. Xavier's High School in Patna and St John's College, Oxford (~1960–1965). He held a post at the University of Oxford from around 1968 to 2005.
Sanjit Kumar Sadhukhan is a scholar of Buddhist studies and Tibetology. He studied under teacher and guide Mrinalkanti Gangopadhyaya and traditional teacher A. P. Lama.

Sanjukta Gupta is an Indology and religious studies scholar educated at the University of Calcutta, Visva-Bharati University (PhD), and Utrecht University (D.Lett. under Jan Gonda). She taught at Jadavpur University, Utrecht University, and the University of Oxford.
Sanne Dokter-Mersch is an Indology scholar who completed her PhD at Leiden University (~2016–2021) under the supervision of Peter Bisschop and Yuko Yokochi.

Sao Htun Hmat Win is a Buddhist studies scholar who studied at Harvard University and under Bhaddanta Narada. He taught at the University of Rangoon, headed research at the International Institute of Advanced Buddhistic Studies, and advised the Ministry of Religious Affairs.

Sara L. McClintock is a scholar of Buddhist studies, philosophy, and Indology who studied at Columbia, CIHTS, Lausanne, and Harvard (PhD, 2002). Her academic appointments include posts at the University of Wisconsin-Madison and Emory University.

Sarah Aoife Richardson is a scholar of Tibetology, art history and archaeology, and Buddhist studies. She completed her PhD in 2016 at the University of Toronto under the supervision of Jennifer Purtle.

Sarah E. Fraser is a scholar in history, archaeology, Buddhist studies, and sinology who studied at the University of Michigan and Kobe University. She held appointments at Northwestern University and the École Pratique des Hautes Études.

Sarah H. Jacoby is a scholar of Tibetology and religious studies who studied at Yale University (~1995–1999) and the University of Virginia (~2000–2007). She has held academic posts at Columbia University (2006–2009) and Northwestern University (2009).

Sarah Harding is a scholar of Tibetology and Buddhist studies who trained under traditional teachers Kalu Rinpoche and Drubpon Lama Tenpa. She held teaching posts at Naropa University (~1992–2018) and a fellowship at the Tsadra Foundation (~2000).

Sarah J. Horton is a scholar of religious studies, Buddhist studies, and Japanology. She studied at Yale University under Stanley Weinstein and served as an assistant professor at Macalester College, attested in 2006.

Sarah Shaw is a Buddhist studies scholar who studied at the University of Oxford under Richard Gombrich and Lance S. Cousins. She has been affiliated with Oxford's Faculty of Oriental Studies, Wolfson College, and the Oxford Centre for Buddhist Studies.
Saraju Rath is a scholar in the fields of Indology and linguistics. She held posts at the International Institute for Asian Studies, attested in 2012 and 2022.

Sarasi Kumar Saraswati (1906–1980) was a scholar of history, archaeology, and Indology who studied under Jitendra Nath Banerjea. He served as Librarian at The Asiatic Society and held a post at the University of Calcutta.
